# task-b1e8ced4: fill the separating row

## Rule
When color-2 regions/form components above and below a blank separator row are vertically aligned, fill that single entire row with color 3. Preserve every other cell. Do not fill other blank rows.

## Evidence
- Demonstration: 10×10 input contained a hollow square-like outline of 2s spanning rows 2–6, with its center horizontal row blank. Output changed that complete row to ten 3s; all other cells were unchanged.
- Accepted test: input had solid blocks of 2s at rows 1–3 and row 5, columns 1–4 (0-indexed); row 4 was all zero. Accepted output filled row 4 with ten 3s, preserving all blocks and remaining zeros.

## Application checks
1. Find a single blank row between vertically aligned color-2 portions.
2. Set all cells in that row to 3.
3. Leave all other rows unchanged; preserve original grid dimensions."
